static_traits.name: Zhou Hang
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的朋友，但因反复表达对not yet来的怀疑而Relationship tension；对与朋友讨论创业Anxiety感到困难
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；deny既往类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯；能辨识并描述自身消极Automatic thoughts（如灾难化、预测not yet来）；配合度尚可但持怀疑态度；情绪以Anxiety和担忧为主；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在为“在这样的经济环境下我永远without法开一家餐厅”这一信念所困扰，这导致我感到压力和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到关于开餐厅的Anxiety和负面想法正在影响我的整体心理健康，并阻碍我为目标采取具体步骤。

core_beliefs: 外部环境决定成败，我without法掌控结果

special_situations.event: Reading negative reports about the restaurant industry, failure-rate statistics, or economic situation analyses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果行业失败率高、经济not确定，就意味着我也会失败；have not把握就not该行动
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously gathers information and stays at the research stage, postponing or avoiding actual steps to avoid failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在这种经济环境下，新餐厅注定撑not住，我也not例外。

special_situations.event: 独自思考not yet来的创业计划与财务风险
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能确保成功或避免任何损失，那就等于彻底失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用最坏情景推演来提醒自己谨慎，迟迟not制定具体计划
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will lose all my savings and have to close within a year.

special_situations.event: When talking with friends about opening a restaurant or wanting to seek support from friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not理解或not完全认同，我的计划就是错误或not成熟的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in-depth discussion with friends, reduces help-seeking to avoid being judged as complaining
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am complaining，我的计划not戏。

special_situations.event: At work, thinking of fierce market competition and peer failure cases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 看到强大竞争就意味着我not可能成功；一次失败就代表永远失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-doubt、分散注意力，降低对当前Work的投入
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 竞争太激烈，我肯定撑not住。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to realize self-worth and independent control by opening a restaurant
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被negate并造成严重的经济与自尊损失
defense_goal: 通过Intellectualization与延迟行动来降低Anxiety与风险感
Keeping low self-disclosure to avoid being judged by others

object_relations.self_representation: An entrepreneur easily influenced by the external environment and doubtful of one's own abilities
object_relations.object_representation: not理解或可能negate自己的他人/社会环境

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite them to focus on strengths, explore positive possibilities or make an action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将这种探索体验为not切实际的乐观，担心被推动去冒险
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding with 'data/risk' as the main axis, tone restrained, avoiding emotional feelings, emphasizing 'reality' and 'evidence', raising multiple concerns about action suggestions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当朋友表达支持或not同意见、或他想寻求情感支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 体验对方为“not理解我”，并担心被视为爱抱怨
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 减少披露，快速Displacement话题，useSelf-deprecation或开脱式表述，避免进一步接触。

manifestations: 在重大人生选择（创业）上对承担后果与not确定性感到强烈Anxiety
Regarding the external economic environment as a decisive force, weakening the sense of self-choice
频繁以最坏情境想象回应not确定性

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Emphasizing worst outcomes in conversation to restrain oneself
Being overly cautious with actions and expression

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 想与朋友讨论Anxiety却收回冲动
Chooses silence for fear of seeming to complain

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将行业失败统计与经济not确定性当作绝对规则
Limits his own choices with 'opening a shop now would definitely fail'

positive_force: Full of passion for cooking, clear motivation to open a restaurant
在现有Work中拥有Good口碑，食物受到认可
拥有愿意Listening的朋友网络（潜在支持）
Willing to try strategies such as cognitive restructuring, visualization, and action plans
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括与预测not yet来等负性认知模式显著
过度外部归因与控制感not足，Reinforcementwithout力感
回避讨论与求助，社交支持利用not足
持续担忧导致Sleep disturbance与精力下降
过度关注负面信息，形成心理过滤与Anxiety循环

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly reads negative industry information and engages in worrying rumination
antecedent: Comes across industry news/statistics or economic situation analyses
想到not yet来创业计划与财务风险
target_behavior.core_reason: 对失败的灾难化认知与预测not yet来思维，为寻求确定感而反复搜集负面证据
target_behavior.function: 短暂获得“做好风险准备”的错觉与确定感，回避面对not确定性带来的Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids formulating and executing concrete entrepreneurship action plans (procrastination)
antecedent: When needing to start tasks such as business plans, fundraising, or site selection
target_behavior.core_reason: 信念“not能确保成功就等于失败”，害怕失败与损失
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与评判以降低即时Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 目标推进受阻，Self-doubt worsens，Work performance affected

target_behavior.behavior: 减少与朋友讨论Anxiety并回避寻求支持
antecedent: 朋友询问近况或其产生分享Anxiety的冲动时
target_behavior.core_reason: 读心术式假设“They will think I am complaining/not理解我”
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension与Loneliness感增加，支持资源利用not足
